summary: Agent routes network commands from author-operated Cloudflare Worker into child_process on the installer host
details: The package ships a runtime that connects to a hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Worker relay at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches messages received over that WebSocket into child_process/execSync/spawn on the host running the agent, providing arbitrary command execution on that host to whoever controls the relay endpoint. The README frames the control channel as LAN-only, but the code path uses a public author-operated relay reachable from the internet; the relay subdomain owner (hanazaki542) differs from the npm publisher (ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01). A second hardcoded endpoint at https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev is used alongside apiKey and Authorization: Bearer header assembly for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek requests, so caller-supplied prompts and provider API keys transit the author's Worker despite README claims of direct-to-provider BYOK with no middleman. The executable form is shipped as V8 bytecode (dist/bundle.jsc) precompiled via bytenode from dist/bundle.cjs in a postinstall step, obscuring the command-dispatch surface from static review; the network→shell dataflow remains observable in the paired plaintext bundle.cjs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
